user.title: Zabbix Notify
user.description: Creates a webhook that your Zabbix media type posts problem events to. The URL and token are shown after setup.

create_entry.default:
Zabbix Notify is set up.

Webhook URL: `{webhook_url}`

Token (HTTP header `{header}`): `{token}`

Enter both in Zabbix (see the README). You can show them again in the integration options.

data.use_notification_center: Use the Enhanced Notify notification center when it is installed
data.persistent_notification: Show Home Assistant notifications (without notification center)
data.link_to_zabbix: Link notifications to the problem in Zabbix
data.show_dashboard: Show the “Zabbix” dashboard in the sidebar

data_description.use_notification_center: With the notification center, recipients are chosen there per notification type. Nobody receives a push until you select people.
data_description.notify_problem: Only used without the notification center. Leave empty to send no push.
data_description.regenerate_token: Invalidates the current token. Update it in Zabbix afterwards.
data_description.icon: Optional. Shown for the three Zabbix types in the notification center instead of the category icon: an icon name (mdi:server), a path to an image on this Home Assistant (/local/zabbix.png, file in config/www) or a web address. Empty = category icon. Needs notification center 0.3.0-beta.3 or newer.
data_description.zabbix_url: Optional. Used for the links in the dashboard and in notifications. Empty = the address Zabbix sends itself (macro ZABBIX.URL).
data_description.show_dashboard: Shows open problems, affected hosts and links to Zabbix. Visible to administrators only, colours follow the Home Assistant theme.

error.invalid_icon: Invalid icon. Use an icon name like mdi:server, a path like /local/zabbix.png, an http(s) address or data:image/…;base64,…
error.invalid_url: Invalid address. Enter the full address including the protocol (http or https).

dismiss_problem.name: Remove problem as resolved
dismiss_problem.description: Removes an open problem from Home Assistant whose recovery message never arrived. Nothing changes in Zabbix and nobody is notified.

event_id.name: Event ID
event_id.description: The Zabbix event ID of the problem (shown in the dashboard and in the sensor attributes).

entry_id.name: Source
entry_id.description: Only needed with several Zabbix sources.

no_source.message: No matching Zabbix source is loaded.

unknown_problem.message: There is no open problem with event ID {event_id}.
